ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited reported no deviation in the utilization of the Rs. 108.60 crore raised through a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a confirmation reiterated by their monitoring agency, ICRA Limited. Approximately Rs. 84.87 crore has been utilized for stated objectives, primarily land purchase and related expenses, with the unutilized balance of Rs. 23.73 crore securely held in fixed deposits and bank accounts. While environmental clearance for a subsidiary project is still in process, there are no material impacts or red flags concerning fund misuse identified in this report.
